title: Process policies, release gates and bounded CI measurements
body:
## Outcome and evidence

Depends on #9 (capacity ceilings), including its exact unchanged portability repair070bb23. No rebase/force-push; any owner-authorized integration must preserve both CHANGELOG entries and corrected capacity disclosure, then validate the resulting head. The owner merges; never push main.

| Requirement | Status | Delivery and remaining limit |
|---|---|---|
| OSS-01 | Owner-action-needed | Contributor Covenant2.1, supported-version/private-report policies delivered; enable GitHub private vulnerability reporting. |
| LFC-01 | Done | Strict SemVer/equality/non-regression CI check; human compatibility classification. |
| ENG-11 | Done | PR template and release-note solo-review disclosure. |
| ENG-05 | Owner-action-needed | Current-model unevaluated label mechanism/monthly reminder delivered; default-branch activation pending; native evaluation unclaimed. |
| ENG-07 | Owner-action-needed | Version/source help and README, pinned actions, reproducible build/tag attestation delivered; signing/protection/release controls pending. |
| ENG-08 | Partial | Forty actual skill-only proxy trials, five repeats/task/arm; native quality inconclusive, baseline deployed. |
| NFR-01 | Partial | Repeatable retained warm-budget failures; native/reference evidence gaps remain. |
| MEM | Done amendment; partial qualification | Approved400 binary MB target and startup/100-health-response measurement, not reference workload. |
| POSIX UAT | Owner-action-needed | Dispatch-only Linux build/UAT job delivered; default-branch activation/dispatch pending. |

**Exact PR head `59ef17882f42ff3429556668bc0038d51a682dd3` is not green.** [PR untrusted42416714374](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42416714374) passed all Windows/Ubuntu/macOS jobs, full POSIX CI and both built-UAT runtimes. Same-head [push untrusted42416710613](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42416710613) failed macOS full-suite nested watcher calibration at5033.604375ms: canary present, watchError null, eventCount0, before the CON-09 review exercise. Its isolated control passed; Ubuntu/Windows passed. Both complete logs retained; a PR pass does not erase the push failure or establish repeatability/cause.

Both surfaced frozen-fixtures checks failed: [PR42416714430](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42416714430)10pass/2fail (large316/long-history347ms), plus20 failed paired warm rows; [push42416710615](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42416710615)11pass/1fail (long-history340ms). Unchanged warm-p95300ms. Exact reports/logs/raw evidence retained outside worktree; no retries, relaxed thresholds or passing-only selection.

|---|---|---|
|42408929961 original|11/1; false-green workflow|long-history347; producer exit1|

Commit1ded648 fixed tee producer-exit masking red-first through direct redirection/always-uploaded evidence. Evaluator/thresholds/permissions unchanged. Current/corrected bundle800865bytes SHA256`5376599c1e59b6e5095a769e51b92e3a5670dcf414a4e5d37e6e3b8e6526ace9`; different hardware/load is not causality.

Paired protocols: baseline`fe475fbb26cd5690a35f33acbb2371c902f3dc58`, candidate`d036eefb889539b14f3cc367982016f89dd63270`; five alternating repeats per fixture/arm,20attempts/no retries. Current large baseline317/308/308/342/307 versus candidate315/308/315/314/310; long-history baseline409/402/403/409/426 versus candidate408/409/412/406/411. All20 raw hashes, manifest/plan bindings, three sources, two bundles,860warm/100cold/40resume counts and unchanged judgments independently checked. Setup/discarded calls are not retained. Current wall942143.218279ms; model unused/credits0, compute cost unknown. Both arms fail every repeat: no candidate-only regression, demonstrated operation-level cause or justified repair/before-after result.

Watcher diagnostics9052b17 preserve the five-second deadline and CON-09 sensitivity. Separately authorized one-shot root/nested [diagnostic42418884068](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42418884068), commit9a938a3, recorded all8expected outcomes passing over two fixed5s windows; raw callbacks/windows/canaries/identity retained and recomputed. This isolated result does not distinguish full-suite cause. No product synchronization repair or native Copilot/host spike. Diagnostic branch remains separate from PR head.

Local commands at PR head passed: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run coverage`, `node --test packages\kernel\test\ci-security.test.ts packages\kernel\test\process-policy.test.ts packages\kernel\test\bench-comparison.test.ts` (25controls), `npm run verify:semver`, `npm run build`, `npm run verify:payload`, `npm run verify:reproducible`. Privacy scans passed before commits/push. Full local POSIX CI is not claimed from Windows.

Skill proxy:40actual trials,15training/5disjoint holdout per arm;16171→16142UTF-8 skill bytes. Baselinefe475fb, unpromoted candidatedc41b1c; retained raw hashes/consumed identities/bundles/evaluator/protocol. Native quality inconclusive. Original registered evaluator/protocol from5413b8a, exact LF-to-CRLF transformation and bytes retained alongside registration outside worktree; newer PR LF evaluator evidence kept separate, never rewritten. Wall10171ms, model unused/credits0, compute unknown. Newer proxy jobs passed but artifacts are not yet independently audited.

Windows shared investigation: entire starter tree identical across baseline/#11/#13/this lane; exact failures were Vitest5000ms deadlines. Five unchanged local controls59/59each (295assertions),179840.8205ms wall; local Node/hardware differ. No reproduced hosted/minimum-runtime cause or justified shared repair; deadlines unchanged.

Exact owner actions: main protection/publication settings; signing identity/key and verified signed annotated tags; private vulnerability reporting; protected release environment/reviewers; owner merge prerequisites/PR under review rules, then activate monthly reminder and dispatch Linux UAT. Native host/model/full reference-workload qualification remain separately observed work.

## Compatibility and release notes

- [ ] Classified the public compatibility impact under PRD §6.5: patch (compatible fix), minor (compatible addition), or major (breaking contract). Before 1.0, breaking changes require a minor increment and migration notes.
- [x] Kernel and plugin SemVer agree; versions never regress.
- [ ] Release notes disclose changed executables, hooks, helpers, permissions, destinations, schemas, evaluators, behavior, support matrix and migration/reconsent requirements, including explicit "No change" statements where applicable.

Additive stateless help fields; preview0.1.0-m0; no persisted-schema change. Approved RSS target300→400binaryMB; observed startup peak123879424bytes versus419430400, not reference qualification. No proxy changes to checks/evaluators/permissions or deployed candidate. Monthly reminder alone requires issues:write; tests remain read-only. Release disclosures delivered; final actual review-window/reviewer record remains owner work.

## Solo-maintainer review (ENG-07, ENG-11)

- [ ] Changes to executable content, hooks, helpers, permissions, destinations or evaluators remain on this public PR for a **72-hour review window** before owner merge. Record the opening time and earliest merge time below.
- [ ] An external reviewer was requested when available. Agent review does not count as second-maintainer review.
- [ ] Release notes state that **no second-maintainer review occurred**, name any external reviewer, and record the actual public review window. Do not claim a window that has not elapsed.

The owner merges; this PR does not authorize publication or bypass release gates.
